camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi DescribeResourceCoverageTotal --region cn-hangzhou --PeriodType HOUR --EndPeriod '2021-01-02_00:00:00' --BillOwnerId 123745698925000 --ResourceType RI --StartPeriod '2021-01-01_00:00:00'
description_en: Queries the total coverage data of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs)
description_zh: 预留实例、SCU覆盖率汇总查询
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi describe-resource-coverage-total --start-period 2021-01-01_00:00:00 --end-period 2021-01-02_00:00:00 --period-type HOUR --bill-owner-id 123745698925000 --resource-type RI --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceCoverageTotal

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The beginning is included in the time range. Specify the time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss； 查询逻辑为包括该时间
parameters.name: start_period

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end is excluded from the time range. If you do not set this parameter, the end time is the current time. Specify the time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；查询逻辑为不包括该时间；为空表示截止到当前时间
parameters.name: end_period

parameters.help_en: The time granularity at which total coverage data is queried. Valid values: MONTH, DAY, and HOUR
parameters.help_zh: MONTH：月维度； DAY：天维度； HOUR：小时维度；
parameters.name: period_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account for which you want to query total coverage data. If you do not set this parameter, the data of the current Alibaba Cloud account and its RAM users is queried. To query the data of a RAM user, specify the ID of the RAM user
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
parameters.name: bill_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The type of deduction plans whose total coverage data is queried. Valid values: RI and SCU
parameters.help_zh: RI：预留实例；SCU：存储容量单位包
parameters.name: resource_type
